name: 40223 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40223 (Louisville) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40223 (Louisville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
